description: Generate a Gridfinity baseplate sized to a known drawer preset. Supply measured drawer dimensions when available and the printer build volume; the tool automatically enables build-plate splitting when the baseplate does not fit.

baseplateType.description: Choose the type of gridfinity baseplate to generate. Tray adds a solid floor under each cell. CLICKbase uses plastic clips instead of magnets.

borderRadius.description: Radius of the rounded corners for each grid unit

connectMarginCrossings.description: Also place a dovetail wherever a split edge crosses from grid cells into a margin region. Off: dovetails only at cell-to-cell crossings.

drawerPresetId.description: Exact preset id returned by find_gridfinity_drawer_presets.

edgeConnectorSides.description: Choose which outer edges receive connector clip holes (back, front, left, right)

enableEdgeConnectors.description: Add connector clips along the outer perimeter edges of the baseplate

gridUnitDepth.description: Depth of each grid unit in millimeters (determines grid unit size and grid spacing)

gridUnitWidth.description: Width of each grid unit in millimeters (determines grid unit size and grid spacing)

magnetDiameter.description: Diameter of the magnets (mm) - determines hole and cube size.

magnetDirection.description: Which side of the baseplate you insert magnets from. Pockets are placed on that side of the magnet-base region.

magnetHeight.description: Height/thickness of the magnets (mm) - determines hole depth

magnetHoleStyle.description: Round holes are sized with your magnet diameter slider. Crush ribs (experimental) use a wavy profile: wider clearance outside, smaller diameter at the rib tips so a standard 6 mm magnet compresses the ribs when pressed in.

marginType.description: Solid: Grid units are placed with margins based on alignment. Margin Fit: Grid units are placed in main grid, and custom-sized connectors fit into margin areas. Half Grid: Half-sized grid units (21 mm for default) fill margins where they fit; the rest stays solid. Use corner alignment (e.g. Top-Left) for larger margins. Overtile: Standard-sized connectors tile across margins, extending beyond baseplate bounds and getting clipped.

measuredDimensions.description: Measured drawer interior dimensions in millimeters. These override the approximate preset dimensions.

partsConnector.description: Experimental dovetails interlock split pieces without separate parts and use your printer tolerance for male tabs. They require Split to Build Plates and work with all baseplate types. Clips connect split seams and optional outer edges; the printable clip model is included (not compatible with Skeleton).

plateMarginMm.description: Safety margin applied on each plate edge

previewTheme.description: Theme of the fallback preview image. Pass "light" when the chat uses a light theme; defaults to dark.

printerBuildVolume.description: The printer build volume used to decide whether this drawer-sized baseplate must be split.

removeHolesOnSplitLines.description: Remove screw holes that fall on split edges to avoid interference with piece connections

screwHeadSize.description: Diameter of the screw head (mm) - determines countersink size

screwHoleSize.description: Diameter of the screw shaft (mm) - determines through-hole size

splitOffMargins.description: Create outer margins as separate strips while keeping corners attached to top or bottom strips.

splitStrategy.description: Choose how to split the baseplate: Fewer Parts minimizes total pieces, Balanced creates evenly-sized pieces, T-Junctions staggers splits to avoid 4-way crosses for better joint strength

splitToBuildplates.description: Override the automatic printer-fit split decision.

toggleMagnetReleaseHole.description: Adds a through-hole at the center of each magnet pocket (half the magnet diameter) so magnets can be pushed back out from the opposite side.

toggleMagnets.description: Add magnet holes to grid unit corners for attaching with magnets

toggleScrewHoles.description: Add countersunk screw holes at grid unit intersections for mounting

tolerance.description: Experimental fit setting saved per printer. For dovetails, 0 mm gives the largest male tab; higher values make it smaller, up to 0.5 mm. Also affects CLICKbase clips and magnet holes. Print the tolerance test package to choose a dovetail fit. Normal bin pockets keep fixed geometry; the included bin-fit sample is a reference check. Values: none = 0 mm, tight = 0.1 mm, standard = 0.2 mm, loose = 0.3 mm, very-loose = 0.4 mm, extra-loose = 0.5 mm.

name: generate_gridfinity_drawer_baseplate

settings.description: Website generator settings encoded in the URL.

split.description: Website split plan, which may be summarized for large previews.

url.description: Open this exact configuration on the website to inspect and export it.
